description.value: Donair Hub is a halal fast-food counter in Langley Township specializing in lamb, beef, chicken, and falafel donairs carved fresh off the rotisserie to order. The menu extends to platters, poutine, and donair bowls, with generous portions that reviewers consistently single out. Delivery is available via Uber Eats, DoorDash, and SkipTheDishes, or customers can dine in or pick up.
